states.name: 展开并查看线索
states.prompt:
Edit the supplied complete Chinese historical reasoning-game UI image into a new interaction state. Keep the exact approved night-camp background, screen framing, dark matte silk palette, small regular KAISHU 楷体 typography, pale fine curves, understated ink-wash materials and header/footer. This is a whole-screen UI art keyframe, not a presentation board. No English, no instructional captions outside the game UI.
This state is BEFORE pressing 推理. Retain the upper-right starting thought “今夜有变，可能试探” and its fine curve to the left question “不惊扰丞相，军情该交给谁？”. Retain the two left evidence strips “今夜不得入帐” and “伯约受命接报”, EXACTLY LEFT-ALIGNED with their small × controls in one column. Retain the short branches from the question to these inputs.
Because inference has not yet been run, REMOVE the right-side result “向姜维请求接报”, its supporting sentences, its “去见姜维” action and the two long input-to-result curves. Do not draw a placeholder box, empty result circle, label or loading indicator. The right canvas is quiet negative space until 推理 is pressed.
Keep the “＋ 添入线索” and small matte cinnabar “推理” button grouped beneath the left clues.

Design the OPEN CLUE SELECTION SLIP anchored DIRECTLY BELOW “＋ 添入线索”. It is a compact floating dark woven-paper sheet, same restrained charcoal material as the clue underwashes, gently irregular fine fibre edge, thin very soft shadow. Width roughly580px on this approximately1672x940 canvas, padding18px, height about185px. It must remain visually secondary to the question. No thick golden frame, opaque black slab, large scalloped outline or big white panel. A tiny top-edge notch points at the plus anchor. Header small “见闻” and one tiny × close control. Six entries in a compact TWO-COLUMN, THREE-ROW layout, all the SAME small Kaishu text as clue labels, no individual boxed cards or grid rules:
left row1 “敌骑尚未攻营” with small＋
right row1 “敌军探问发令者” with small＋
left row2 “亲兵可通传” with small＋ unless selected in the requested state
right row2 “递话，不能决断” with small＋
left row3 “今夜不得入帐” with a dim ✓
right row3 “伯约受命接报” with a dim ✓.
The row3 entries are already on the canvas, so muted but still readable. Each plus/check is on the SAME LINE aligned at the end of its column. No checkboxes, no extra “confirm”, “加入所选”, “取消” or bottom action bar. Clicking a plus adds immediately and leaves the slip open; clicking the words opens nearby details. This is only depicted visually, no instructional text.
Use small regular Kaishu for ALL text including the popup and buttons. Two compact text sizes, same as the source, no large headline. Preserve exact Chinese spelling. No new story content, characters, props, highlights in the background, menu search field or numeric badges.
STATE A — OPEN PICKER WITH ADJACENT DETAIL:
Only the two original evidence nodes are on the left canvas. Keep their position and the existing add/infer row approximately unchanged. The choice slip opens below, around x=430,y=540, extends to x=1010,y=730, fitting the empty lower canvas.
The player has clicked the WORDS “亲兵可通传” in the slip, but has not added it. Its row has only a faint active fibre wash; its trailing ＋ remains.
Show one small floating detail sheet immediately to the RIGHT of that same row, around x=1030,y=590, width320px, height150px. It must clearly be adjacent to the clicked list row, never centered over the canvas and never cover the clue list or main question. Same matte dark woven-paper surface and delicate material edge as the selection slip, with a small left-edge notch facing the row, not a long connector. Small title “亲兵可通传”, tiny × at top right, then two readable small text lines/paragraphs:
“可以由亲兵到帐外递话。”
“通传不等于已得到姜维的答复。”
Do not add a large heading, type label, citation, confirm button or underline. This is a quiet precise hover/click inspection layout, with the selection slip staying open beneath the plus control.

interactionDesign: Click 添入线索 to open an anchored two-column inventory slip.
Click an entry's words to inspect source and meaning in an adjacent collision-aware popup.
Click the row's plus to add immediately and keep the picker open for further choices; no extra confirmation.
New clue is appended under existing clues with text, underwash and remove control left-aligned; active controls/picker follow the new row.
Already added inventory items show checks and cannot be duplicated.
Click outside, close control or Escape to dismiss; keyboard focus returns to its anchor.
Shown states are before inference. Adding clues does not create a right-hand outcome or result connections; 推理 does.
Preserve fixed-size scroll viewport; when newly added content would clip, scroll only enough to reveal it and reposition picker/nearby details.
scopeNotes: 亲兵可通传 illustrates selecting an existing inventory clue, not adding new formal story.
Exact typography, motion and collision behavior must be implemented and tested in code.
These frames do not specify how to edit completed historical rounds.
